name: patient.appointment.reminder
description: Send proactive reminders to patients before their upcoming appointments. Reduces no-shows and improves patient outcomes.
author: DoctaRx Genesis

steps.name: Fetch appointments in next 24 hours
steps.query: SELECT a.*, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, p.first_name as provider_first, p.last_name as provider_last FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.patient_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users p ON a.provider_id = p.id WHERE a.scheduled_at > NOW() AND a.scheduled_at < NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours' AND a.status = 'scheduled'

steps.name: Filter patients who haven't been reminded
